cross_references.relationship: remedies — §52 provides statutory damages ($4,000 minimum per violation), treble actual damages, civil penalties, and attorney's fees for Unruh Act violations
sibling — Bane Act protects rights from interference by coercion; Unruh Act protects access to businesses from discrimination. Different scope, different elements.
federal counterpart — ADA Title III prohibits discrimination by public accommodations. §51(f) makes any ADA violation automatically an Unruh Act violation, with Unruh's statutory damages.
